name: Lifesize Plans
summary:
Explore your plans in 3D with the Lifesize plans app. Take your 2D floor plan and transform it into a VR experience that you can walk around and explore in perfect scale. Get a feel for the size and layout of your space and compare different designs side by side. Whether you're an architect, designer, or home builder, the Lifesize plans app will help bring your plans to life.
